verdict.rationale: Codegen's API docs list "Trigger agents from CI/CD pipelines when builds fail" as a use case. The API and SDK let a pipeline start an agent with a prompt, and the agent can fix bugs and open pull requests. This is the product's own documented capability, but CI triggering is only a one-line mention with no dedicated integration or worked example, so how far it goes is unproven. Missing for 10: a CI-native integration (e.g. a GitHub Action or pipeline plugin), a documented end-to-end example of passing build or test failure context to the agent, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trigger an agent from CI/CD pipelines to fix a broken build or failing test
